module.name: Devices
module.changelog: *1.3.1* Fixes deleting a device with call history, which failed in 1.3.0 *1.3.0* Internal reorganisation only, with no change to what the module does: the one class the module was written in is now ten, each owning one thing, and saving a device no longer reads the web request directly. Any code calling this module's methods directly should be checked against the new names *1.2.2* The device list sorts only by the columns it offers and no longer names the asterisk database on its own query, so it works on an install that renamed it; the mailbox, User Manager and call history handling has moved into files of its own *1.2.1* A renumbered Extension/User takes its call history with it, and its mailbox now keeps the alias that makes message waiting and *97 work *1.2.0* The Extension/User number is editable: it renumbers the extension, its User Manager account, its mailbox and any handset pointed at it, and a number already in use is refused *1.1.0* Extension/User devices create and remove their user, User Manager account and email; sequential device ids; reload on save and delete *1.0.1* New
